test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

This lock will not open unless you __don’t use__ the correct code.
solution:
The correct answer is **'use'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we observe the sentence, we get to know **the conjunction 'unless' is used.**
 
• We use the conjunction **'unless'** to mean **'except if'.**
 
• ***The clause which follows 'unless' is a subordinate clause and it needs a main clause to make a complete sentence.***
 
 
• We will go for a picnic **unless** it rains.
 
• They will not come **unless **you invite them.
 
 
 
• By observing the above sentences,** the given sentence must be **- *This lock will not open **unless**__ you __**use **__the correct code.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Let's understand the concept with some more examples.

 
• I will not pay if you don't provide the detail.
 
 
• *I will not pay **unless **you provide the detail*.
 
 
 
• She would be here by now if she was not stuck in traffic.
 
 
• *She would be here by now **unless **she was stuck in traffic.*
 
 
 
• They would have shot him if he hadn't given them the money.
 
 
• *They would have shot him **unless **he had given them the money.*
